shopSections.title: Premium Cake
shopSections.description: Signature whole cakes crafted from the finest ingredients. Multi-layer indulgence with contrasting textures and complementary flavours.

shopSections.title: Collection Cake
shopSections.description: Everyday loaves, brownies and cookies — classic delights with timeless flavours for any occasion.

shopSections.title: Box Edition
shopSections.description: Cookie jars curated for gifting and sharing. Thoughtfully packed and ready to bring home.

products.name: Caramel Espresso Gateau
products.summary: Buttery vanilla layers swirled with rich salted caramel and topped with a generous scatter of toasted macadamia nuts. Nutty, indulgent, and beautifully balanced.

products.name: Lemon Yuzu Cake
products.summary: A bright, citrus-forward sponge that pairs Mediterranean lemon with the floral zing of Japanese yuzu. Light, refreshing, and impossible to resist.

products.name: Matcha Marmalade
products.summary: Earthy ceremonial-grade matcha cake layered with a tangy yuzu-citrus marmalade. A grown-up balance of bitter, sweet, and bright.

products.name: Strawberry Shortcake
products.summary: Classic Japanese-style shortcake — airy chiffon sponge, freshly whipped cream, and ripe strawberries layered through every bite.

products.name: Mixed Fruit Basque Cheesecake

images.alt: Mixed Fruit Basque Cheesecake — alternative angle

products.summary: Our signature burnt Basque cheesecake topped with a colourful medley of seasonal fruits. Caramelised on top, custardy in the centre, and bursting with freshness.

products.name: Jasmine Blanc Cheesecake
products.summary: A delicate twist on our Basque cheesecake — infused with fragrant jasmine tea for a floral, elegant finish that lingers on the palate.

products.name: Pistachio Noir Cheesecake
products.summary: Finely ground pistachios folded through our burnt Basque cheesecake, finished with a deeply caramelised top and a whisper of dark chocolate. Nutty, rich, and quietly luxurious.

products.name: Tiramisu Noir Cheesecake
products.summary: The Italian classic reimagined as a burnt Basque cheesecake — espresso-soaked layers, mascarpone cream, and a dusting of cocoa over a caramelised top.

products.name: Citron Basque Cheesecake
products.summary: Bright lemon zest folded through our signature burnt Basque cheesecake. Tangy, creamy, and gently caramelised — a dessert that wakes you up.

products.name: Truffle Basque Cheesecake
products.summary: Our most decadent Basque cheesecake — laced with rich dark chocolate truffle ganache and finished with a deeply caramelised top. For serious chocolate lovers.

products.name: Lemon Pound Cake
products.summary: A classic loaf with a buttery, dense crumb and a punchy lemon glaze. Comforting and timeless — perfect with coffee or tea.

products.name: Banana Walnut Loaf
products.summary: Ripe bananas folded into a moist, tender loaf with toasted walnuts in every slice. Warm, comforting, and impossibly moreish.

products.name: Chocolate Brownie
products.summary: Fudgy on the inside, lightly crisp on top, and made with a generous hit of dark chocolate. Intense, satisfying, and best enjoyed warm.

products.name: Chocolate Chip Soft Cookies

images.alt: Chocolate Chip Soft Cookies — alternative angle

products.summary: Thick, soft-baked cookies with pools of melted dark chocolate. Soft centre, golden edges — best enjoyed warm with a glass of cold milk.

products.name: Matcha Pistachio Soft Cookies
products.summary: Buttery soft cookies infused with ceremonial-grade matcha and studded with chopped pistachios. Earthy, nutty, and gently sweet.

products.name: Assorted Cookies Jar
products.summary: A curated jar bringing together our most-loved cookies — chocolate chip, butter, matcha and more. Perfect for gifting or sharing at home.

products.name: Butter Cookies Jar
products.summary: A jar of crumbly, melt-in-the-mouth butter cookies made with French cultured butter. Simple, timeless, and always welcome.

products.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies Jar
products.summary: Our signature chocolate chip cookies packed into a generous jar. Soft centres, golden edges, and plenty of dark chocolate in every bite.

products.name: Chocolate Cookies Jar
products.summary: Deep cocoa cookies with rich dark chocolate chunks, baked until just chewy. For anyone who likes their chocolate doubled.

products.name: Matcha Cookies Jar
products.summary: Buttery matcha cookies tucked into a jar — earthy, gently sweet, and impossible to stop at one.
